content: Do you have the Sunrise sunflower oil 1 litre pack and what is the current retailer price?
The 1 litre pack is available. The current retailer price is INR 128 and MRP is INR 145.
I may take 20 bottles. Is there any scheme?
The November oil scheme gives 5% off at 10 units. I can record your interest in 20 bottles.
